title: Figure 16: 'Plasmonic molecule' exhibiting electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT)
description: Two side-by-side false-color field-intensity maps: left, a single vertical radiative metal strip; right, the radiative strip coupled to a dark element of two horizontal strips, with a color bar from 0 to 40.0. Caption: "Figure 16. 'Plasmonic Molecule' Exhibiting EIT." The color bar is the field magnitude normalized to the incident laser field at λ = 700 nm.
